[Home](https://www.cityofwilliston.com/state_of_the_city.php) /  [Residents](https://www.cityofwilliston.com/state_of_the_city.php/residents/index.php) /  State of the City

The 2025 State of the City is Thursday, May 15th from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at the Old Armory located at 320 1st Avenue East.

In addition to in-person, the State of the City will be live streamed to the City of Williston Facebook page (@cityofwilliston) and broadcast live on the radio via 660 KEYZ.

This year's speakers included:

- City of Williston Mayor Howard Klug
- City Administrator Shawn Wenko
- Finance Director Hercules Cummings
- City Engineer David Juma
- WBSD7 Superintendent Dr. Jason Germundson
- Williston Economic Development Director Anna Nelson

The State of the City Address is an annual event that provides important City updates on current initiatives, projects, partnerships, and more.

The State of the City presentation can be found [here](https://www.cityofwilliston.com/state_of_the_city.php/State%20of%20the%20City%20-%20FINAL%20.pdf).
